end_date_convention: 9999-12-31 for still-active before clip; after CSI300 intersect clipped to membership/calendar
pit_inference_rule: Source Excel gives industry entry dates (计入日期) per stock without explicit exit dates. For each stock, rows are sorted by entry date; start_date = entry; end_date = day before the next entry; the last segment uses open end 9999-12-31 before intersecting with CSI300 membership and the local calendar. 6-digit SW industry codes are mapped to L1 index codes via code prefix.
limitations: Official SW workbook is a point-in-time classification history, but exit dates are inferred. Some SW2014 prefixes are mapped to the closest L1 index code (e.g. 采掘 801020; 信息设备-era 32xx -> 计算机 801750). Coverage depends on workbook completeness for delisted names.
